headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 26, 2026**
article:
The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 1-0 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Drew Rasmussen earning the win after 7.0 innings of scoreless ball. CJ Abrams led the Washington Nationals' offense with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 3 RBIs in their 10-7 win over the Arizona Diamondbacks. The Boston Red Sox secured a 6-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Jarren Duran leading the Red Sox offense with 3 hits and 2 RBIs.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list, including Cody Bellinger of the New York Yankees, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain. Other notable injuries include Shea Langeliers of the Athletics, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 25, 2026, with a torn meniscus in his right knee.

The St. Louis Cardinals have traded RHP Scott Blewett to the Athletics for cash. Additionally, the Chicago White Sox acquired RHP José Urquidy from the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for RHP Felix Doroteo. The Washington Nationals traded LHP Connelly Early to the Washington Nationals for 3B Curtis Mead, while the Philadelphia Phillies acquired CF Kameron Misner from the Kansas City Royals for cash.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Guardians in Low-Scoring Affair**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays edged out the Cleveland Guardians 1-0, with Drew Rasmussen earning the win after 7.0 innings of scoreless ball, striking out 9 and walking 1.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Diamondbacks 10-7**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 7-10 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with CJ Abrams leading the offense with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 3 RBIs. Max Kranick pitched a strong 1.0 inning in relief, striking out 1 batter without allowing an earned run.

top_news.title: **Cubs Fall Short in Pittsburgh**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs dropped a 7-8 decision to the Pittsburgh Pirates, marking their latest loss. Ryan O'Hearn led the Cubs' offense with a home run and four RBIs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Fall to Red Sox in 6-1 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 6-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Jarren Duran leading the Red Sox offense with 3 hits and 2 RBIs. Ranger Suarez pitched 4 strong innings for the Blue Jays, striking out 6 batters and allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Place Cody Bellinger on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Cody Bellinger, left fielder for the New York Yankees, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain. This move comes after an injury on July 26, 2026.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Make Roster Move Ahead of Trade Deadline**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals have traded RHP Scott Blewett to the Athletics for cash.
